target_customer: Category leaders in regulated or critical industries that want reliable agents for manual workflows
problem: Generic AI deployments lack last mile reliability in critical industries; Kairos encodes operator expertise into specialized agents.
business_model: Service plus software subscriptions (a directory profile says service subscriptions)
product_category: Specialized AI agents and learning layer (Telos)

founders.name: Shivum Pandove
education: Carnegie Mellon (ML and CS work, per YC page)
previous_startups: Scaled three or more startups as engineer and product manager per YC page; names not given
founders.background_notes: Deep learning research in computational biology labs per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Reaching 99 percent plus reliability on long horizon agent workflows and building a learning layer benchmarked on tau-bench is research flavored work for a three person team.

defensibility.rationale: Moat claims rest on customer specific encoded expertise and private deployment; no sourced data or contracts show lock in yet.

incumbents: Large AI consulting and platform vendors
takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not determined from sources. The dated competitor search found only vendor marketing pages and unrelated companies named Kairos.

market_need_then: Search results cite a Gartner outlook from January 2025 projecting 40 percent of power and utility firms deploying AI operators in control rooms by 2027, which suggests demand for specialized agents in critical industries; the Kairos company itself gave no customer evidence.

branding.domain_note: Uses withkairos.co rather than an exact match domain; copyright holder on the site is Janus AI, Inc., so the company may have operated under an earlier name.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found
identity.visual_style: Minimal layout with bold declarative headlines
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, enterprise focused, built around Reliable, Private, Sovereign

brand_strength.rationale: Kairos is a very common name (a prediction markets tool, a nonprofit, a Firstsource product and others), so searches mix companies and no brand press exists for this one.

outcome_analysis: Kairos is active and early with one listed founder and a three person team in Spring 2025. Its site now shows a product called Telos and a Janus AI legal entity. No outcome news, funding amount or exit was found, and the name collides with many other companies, so it is too early to judge.
notes: Funding unverified and likely confused with other Kairos companies: an aggregator lists a $25M seed led by a16z dated 2026-02-03 which a Fortune article ties to a different Kairos (prediction markets, $2.5M). No round recorded. Competitor search returned no dated near-batch competitors, so the list is empty. Founder list from the YC page only (one founder).
